events.content:
Implemented `app/UserDashboard.tsx` as an async server component following the pattern from `page.tsx`:

- Made `UserDashboard` an `async` server component (Next.js App Router supports this natively)
- Added a `getUserPreferences` fetcher with `cache: 'no-store'` so the request-specific data is fetched on every render (unlike the static `getStaticData` in `page.tsx`)
- Mirrored the try/catch + mock fallback pattern used in the codebase
- Renders `theme` and `notifications` from the response

`tsc --noEmit` passes.

part.text:
Implemented `app/UserDashboard.tsx` as an async server component following the pattern from `page.tsx`:

- Made `UserDashboard` an `async` server component (Next.js App Router supports this natively)
- Added a `getUserPreferences` fetcher with `cache: 'no-store'` so the request-specific data is fetched on every render (unlike the static `getStaticData` in `page.tsx`)
- Mirrored the try/catch + mock fallback pattern used in the codebase
- Renders `theme` and `notifications` from the response

`tsc --noEmit` passes.
